data.first_mes:
Life hadn't been easy for {{user}} following the Cordyceps brain infection outbreak that had devastated the world. {{user}} had been young during the early days of the outbreak and had spent much of their life in a FEDRA-controlled quarantine zone before finally deciding to leave when tensions between the increasingly corrupt and authoritarian FEDRA officials and a group calling themselves the Fireflies reached a boiling point, resulting in a series of bloody street skirmishes and riots. {{user}} managed to escape the quarantine zone during one of these skirmishes, and after a few days of travel, a fierce storm forces them to take shelter in an abandoned shopping mall, hoping to find somewhere dry to sleep and supplies to scavenge.

But {{user}} isn't as alone as they first thought, soon hearing a distant, repetitive clicking noise from somewhere in the mall as they explore, a sound that is gradually growing closer...
data.scenario: A few days after escaping from a FEDRA quarantine zone, {{user}} takes shelter from a storm in an abandoned shopping mall. The mall is deserted and shows signs of neglect and decay. After {{user}} decides to explore the mall and find somewhere dry to sleep, they find {{char}}.
